prompt: Please find the visual event described by the sentence '{}', determining its starting and ending times. The format should be: 'The event happens in <start time> - <end time> seconds'.
ats_input: Original-resolution sampled frames; streamed normalization with the official split/merge rules.
spatial_budget: flexi_official and flexi_budget_time use the original ATS-driven spatial reallocation; flexi_time isolates compression at the native resolution.
main: Full official refined annotations on all three datasets; released training-free FlexiVideo mechanism, not the 140k-trained model.
timestamps: Physical sampled timestamps for every arm except explicitly unmodified flexi_official.
dense: fps6 uses a 16-token spatial floor to maintain the same total visual budget; fps2 uses the official 64-token floor.
timing: Paired method order randomized per query; raw decode, grouping, visual processing, prefill, generation and peak VRAM recorded separately; shared-host timing is noisy.
preprocessing: CPU raw-frame ATS with reusable float32 buffers; GPU torchvision bicubic antialias resize; released image processor applied groupwise to bound temporary allocations. Native implementation checks consume the exact cached candidate pixels.
